reviews.author: Jean Carter
reviews.text: I really appreciate this company helping me out when it started getting hot in my beach house. They came quickly fixed the problem and house started getting cool in no time. reviews.text: I had been without air-conditioning for an entire night. I called down East in the morning Monday morning and when they showed up, they got to work immediately. They explained what was wrong with my air-conditioning unit and to my limited knowledge it sounded like they knew what they were talking about. At the end of the day when they left, I had a nice Cool and refreshing temperature. They offered the twice a year option for maintenance which I was happy to accept. They were knowledgeable and friendly.

He’s one of the most courteous and professional service people I’ve ever run into and I will make sure that I ask for him every time we need their service. We also decided because of that experience to sign up for the annual check up VIP plan. I highly recommend Down East and especially Nicholas.

reviews.author: Dayngr
reviews.text: Down East Heating & Cooling Update: Absolutely disappointed! I wrote a rave review back in March. Turns out the work I thought was thorough was in fact, not thorough at all. Now, 3 months later, I called again to report it was hot in the house. Different tech came out and wrote "Found the duct run that feeds all the vents to the master bedroom was disconnected for the plenum. Reattached the duct and the system is running normal." Reattached. That means it was NOT attached properly. This repair should have been covered since it was to fix faulty work done back in March. $134.00 for a trip fee + $112.00 duct repair to fix what the previous tech, Chris, didn't handle. Total $246.00 I called the office and sent an email addressing what happened and did not hear back. Now, I'd like a full refund. I should not have to pay because the previous tech did not do a thorough job in securing the duct run. * On a side note, I replaced the entire 5 ton unit back in 2017 and at that time was not advised that there were issues with duct not being connected and missing dampers. The March 2024 repairs were to complete the work that was missed in 2017. We had 7 years of heating and cooling issues without being aware that the work was not thorough and complete back in 2017. Previous Review: Technician (Chris) was very thorough, thoughtful, and knowledgeable. Fixed my issues & we were warm once again!

I want to thank Chris for being so efficient, polite and courteous to me and for taking care repair my air conditioning unit in a timely manner. reviews.author: Herberth Claros
reviews.text: We had this company come out to repair our air conditioning in the summer. While the AC issue seemed resolved at the time, we later discovered that the technician bypassed part of the system, which directly caused our heat to stop working during the winter. The technician documented that the system was bypassed, until the part was replaced and after the part was replaced the system was left bypassed. As a homeowner, I expect any bypasses or system modifications, especially ones that affect heating, to be clearly disclosed. What’s most disappointing is that this issue was a direct result of their work, not normal wear and tear. A professional HVAC company should ensure the system is fully functional after any repair and leave the system running normally not in a bypassed state. I strongly recommend to NOT use this company based on poor workmanship and lack of communication. We’re now paying additional money to fix a problem that shouldn’t have existed in the first place.

reviews.author: Elena Messenger
reviews.text: Again, and as always, a great experience w Nick helping ensure my HVAC is in tip top shape. His detailed explanations and very timely service are so appreciated.

reviews.author: Crystal Brown
reviews.text: Nick is always great to work with. He always takes the time to explain the findings as well as the cost breakdown. He is very professional and knowledgeable. What a great asset to your team!

reviews.author: Marie Armstrong
reviews.text: Nick came to our yearly check. He was awesome. He was knowledgeable, courteous and respectful. I even recommended the company to a neighbor because of him.

reviews.author: Carol Cordoni
reviews.text: We were impressed by the quick appointment we received today. Our service technician,Mathias, was polite, efficient, and knowledgeable! He communicates well and completed the repair quickly.

reviews.author: John Burnham
reviews.text: Nick is a super great guy!! You have a real asset in Nick Perry!! Take care of this man, it's hard to find quality people. If he's not one of your top preformers I'd be surprised.

reviews.author: Alina Vazquez
reviews.text: Nick provided excelent service , was great at communicating what he had done, how to manage certain pain point with the AC system, he was on time, very respectful and professional. Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: John Marshall
reviews.text: We have used them for more than 22 years. Charges have been consistently within reason and the service remarkably timely, which is especially appreciated since essential to the comfort and health of my now-99 yo mom. No complaints.

reviews.author: Sharon Woods
reviews.text: Had a great experience. Nick was very thorough and helpful. He patiently answered our questions. We were very pleased with the service.

reviews.author: T Abbey
reviews.text: Tech team of 4 plus showed up on time and worked throughout the day in replacing two HVAC systems (outside pumps and inside air handlers). Cody was extra patient in doing the initial set up of the thermostats. House is cooling nicely. We look forward to the cost savings on the electric bill thanks to the new high efficient systems!

reviews.author: Frankie Brown
reviews.text: Great experience with technician DOWN EAST East Chris Ervin. Chris was very knoweledgeable and professional. Chris performed a complete inspection and Diagnostics then presented and explained to me what the issues were. He presented me with all the options for repair and returning unit to service.

reviews.author: Jennifer Argall
reviews.text: Down East came out today same day we called!! The gentleman we had was able to determine the issue quickly and began work immediately. He did a great job and was very kind.

reviews.author: Rhonda Parker
reviews.text: Brian was very knowledgeable and very thorough when diagnosing the problem and find solutions. He went over everything with me and answered all questions so that I was comfortable with the decision I made. I was very pleased with the service received today.

reviews.author: Sara Myrick
reviews.text: Nick was wonderful to work with and got my home squared away to continue battling the hot, humid summer temperatures. He is very professional and courteous.

reviews.author: Avi8 Lass
reviews.text: Excellent, professional timely service from Down East Heating & Cooling. Chris fixed a leak in the line and also replaced some blown fuses. Strongly recommend to others. Company was fast to respond on a very cold day.

reviews.author: Rosalee Bowman
reviews.text: Downeast has always been quick and efficient. They service our restaurant and do an awesome job. So when our home needed some AC urgent care, they were right there and we are all taken care of. I highly recommend Downeast for your HAVAC needs.

reviews.author: Betsy Marcum
reviews.text: Nick came and quickly diagnosed the water condensate situation. He sealed the vent and around the light and then tested it. He answered many questions and was very congenial.

reviews.author: TERRI CODY
reviews.text: Very professional and prompt. Highly recommend this company. Nick was very respectful and efficient.

reviews.author: M Abila
reviews.text: Very quick and polite service. Gave a quote and were able to install new system in my rental unit quickly.

reviews.author: Troy Tamafaalagia
reviews.text: Our interactions with this company has all been positive so far. They follow through with their word, do the work and fix the problems we had with our air unit. Everyone with this company that we speak to have all been polite and friendly. The technicians are professional and polite.

reviews.author: Melana Griffee
reviews.text: Our Tech, Nick, was super friendly and completed a thorough check of our system to make sure it’s running properly! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Von Straight
reviews.text: Nick did an excellent job doing our yearly hvac tune up. He was prompt and communicated everything excellently.

reviews.author: Kenneth Riddle
reviews.text: Cannot say enough about how awesome Down East Heating And Air conditioning is especially their technician Cody true professional diagnose the problem I got my problem solved very quickly. Amazing job.

reviews.author: Eddie Pollock
reviews.text: It is very refreshing to have a technician show up and be educated and skilled in their knowledge of the work they are performing. I can tell that Down East really emphasizes the training for their technicians! First class all around!

reviews.author: Diane Saylor
reviews.text: The drain flow overflowed because it was clogged. A technician was able to come out within hours of my call and cleaned the water leak and unclogged our system. He was friendly and explained what had happened and answered the questions I asked. Will use them again for maintenance and repairs!

reviews.author: Jerry Thomas
reviews.text: Chris and Justin were Polite, Courteous, Extremely knowledgeable and very detailed in the performance their job. They were really Professional and a credit to the company. Thank you Down East Heating and Air for sending these two men.

reviews.author: claudette harris
reviews.text: Down East Heating and Air . Have serviced our units for years. Cody who came today was polite, knowledgeable and professional . He answered all questions I had and made sure to actually show me what the issue was. He seem to be training someone as well. Thank you again

reviews.author: Mickhel Yawn
reviews.text: Our technician Cody was very courteous and polite. Communicated very easily the answers to our questions. Pricing very reasonable. Highly recommend!
